normal_scientific_entry.checkpoints: Every complete stage returns a full physical/map NPZ coordinate identity and its independent uncut small JSON report.

mathematics: R752 supplies one fixed complete target metric. Two families of normal rays traverse the whole physical end bands. Independent finite rays measure Jacobi evolution, accumulated length, landing, angular separation and actual reconstructed fixed-coordinate residual. Physical and map coefficients jointly specify the deforming closed body; the final same-worker comparison evaluates both complete cap interiors, the middle and both rolled collars. Full finite mesh topology and geometry include all candidate triangle contacts, vertex-pair diameter, candidate ordered normal chords, signed body moments and two-sided initial-image displacement. These numerical arrays and returning diagnostics have their stated discrete scope.
